Delete every  character everywhere, including code delimiters; remove ,  and  everywhere except inside the contents of inline code spans and fenced code blocks, whose contents must otherwise remain unchanged after their backtick delimiters are removed. Remove all matches on a line, remove only the inner link in nested forms such as [text] and any resulting empty [], do not match links across line breaks, preserve all other original characters including whitespace and line breaks exactly, and output only the sanitized text with no commentary or wrapper formatting. 



Strongest “zeroidlecost, no keep_warm GPU billing” approach is to eliminate the whole cold path by restoring a fully initialized GPU state via Modal GPU memory snapshots (bypass weight load/torch.compile/CUDA graph capture), ideally after warming once, so later restores land in seconds not minutes Scale to Zero for LLM Inference: Why Cold Starts Are a WeightLoading ProblemReducing GPU Cold Starts with Memory Snapshots: Restoring CUDA Workloads in Seconds. For your 131k context / KVbuffer sizing bottlenecks, also cut snapshot bloat by discarding perrequest KV cache via engine sleepbeforesnapshot (snapshot weights/compiled kernels, not request KV). For the remaining “fast first token” gap, add predictive KV/prefix warming + sessionsticky routing so requests hit alreadycomputed prefixes instead of paying TTFT again Predictive KV Cache Warming in Production LLM Serving: Architecture, Session Prefetching, and TTFT Latency Shaving — LLMs BlogvLLM KV Cache Reuse: Cut Inference Costs by 78%+.
